name: archboard-svg
responsibility: Writes a scene as one standalone SVG document whose words are the glyphs that the core shaped
description: Writes the scene with its definitions, theme tokens and the near and far stylesheet. A document that stands alone carries the value of every token it names. The one shared chip moves and scales. Both layers of words move on a shared baseline and fade over one span with complementary opacity. Reduced motion cuts the swap.

outgoing.label: the outline of each glyph it defines
